name: The Herald Wakes
objective: Five of six bells are yours — and that is enough for the Frost Herald. Something ancient wearing a crown of ice rises to collect them.
intro: The glacier at the summit's heart splits like a throat. What steps out is Pokémon-shaped, and wrong, and singing.
dialogue: The Frost Herald: "FIVE OF SIX. THE THROAT OF WINTER OPENS."
The Frost Herald (defeated): "THE LAST BELL WILL RING. IT ALWAYS RINGS."
lore_discovery: The Herald is defeated — and simply bows, unmelting, before sinking back into the glacier. It was not the thing beneath the ice. It was its mouthpiece.
